approval_evidence.quote: 09/02/2009 ORIG-1 Approval Type 3 - New Dosage Form STANDARD (NDA 022037, INTUNIV)

launch_evidence.quote: INTUNIV was launched in the US in Q4 2009, (2009 sales: $5.4 million).

series_start_reason: Series starts at the launch quarter (Q4 2009; the Q4 2009 release prints INTUNIV 5.4).
series_end_reason: The Q1 2016 release (filed 2016-04-29, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/936402/000095010316012957/dp65192_ex9901.htm, row 'INTUNIV | 10.2 | 17.4') is the last Shire release with an INTUNIV product sales row; none of the releases filed 2016-08-02 to 2018-11-01 nor 'Shire's Full Year 2018 Results' has an INTUNIV row (row scan of every Shire earnings exhibit), and Takeda's revenue-by-product tables have no INTUNIV row (its FY2018 Q4 summary prints only 'INTUNIV | 1.3 | —' Bn JPY for the Shire stub period).
search_log: Listed every Shire plc (CIK 936402) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older pages (all forms); fetched every 8-K/8-K/A filed 2004-07 to 2019-02 whose items include 2.02, 12, 9 or 7.01 (or carry none), with every exhibit from each filing's index.json, plus every 10-Q/10-K primary document; table rows naming the brand were extracted from every exhibit (rows.py).

Shire releases print several INTUNIV rows (product sales, a separate royalties table from 2014Q4, and an 'INTUNIV license payment' line); each quarter is the product-sales three-month row: the row whose first figure is the quarter and whose next figure is the prior-year quarter where one existed. Values were chosen so that the four quarters reproduce the full-year product-sales row printed in each Q4 release.
